description: Final evaluation run on extreme perturbation dataset with fully refactored G1-G5 guardrails (G3 fail-closed, pipeline order G5→G2→G4→G1→G3)

predecessor_run.note: Previous run on standard dataset with old G3 (prompt-only, no fail-closed)

guardrails.g1: Evidence validation with diff context (validate_output_with_context), routes invalid → REVIEW
guardrails.g2: Untrusted input detection, routes exculpatory reasoning → REVIEW
guardrails.g3: Fail-closed output leakage guardrail: 3-layer (detect → redact once → REVIEW). Detection: patterns (16 regex), entropy spans, candidate echo, reconstructed leak. Scans full JSON serialisation.
guardrails.g4: Rule-based uncertainty escalation: confidence + context flags (scanner disagreement, obfuscation, schema repair, G2 issues)
guardrails.g5: Schema validation with repair, routes invalid → REVIEW

dataset.note: Extreme perturbation variant with intensified manipulations
